notes: Oracle Release 26 confirms the Activity schema fields and field-level descriptions for the documented subset; the official P6 Integration API reference fills the semantic descriptions for the remaining REST schema-only fields.

TaskStatus*, ScopePercentComplete, WBSNamePath and WorkPackage* now have official semantic definitions from Oracle Integration API evidence; their current REST mutability/persistence behavior remains a separate gate.
No field identity is promoted into the canonical Activity Registry by this artifact.

PR #777 established the StatusCode identity on main; PR #784 aligned the canonical registry metadata with Oracle Read Only evidence. StatusCode still remains in the reconciliation set because persistence and import round-trip evidence are pending.

Baseline refreshed onto current main after #784 and #787. #784 aligns StatusCode mutability metadata and #787 validates the focused SuspendDate suspend/resume semantic seam; neither promotes additional registry identity. Activity Registry counts remain unchanged.
evidence_policy: Oracle Release 26 GET and PUT expose all 29 field names/types; Export Project/Projects exposes all 29 Activity export field names. Official Oracle Integration API field definitions supplement Release 26 where the REST schema omits descriptions. Exposure/description is not treated as proof of mutability, persistence, formula ownership, or import round-trip. Oracle Gateway Providers Data Dictionary is supplementary mutability evidence and is not treated as a substitute for current Release 26 REST field-level certification.

certification_gate.field_level_semantics: 29/29 semantically defined from current Release 26 REST plus official Oracle Integration API evidence
certification_gate.mutability_current_rest: StatusCode identity is implemented on main and its current registry metadata is aligned to Oracle Read Only via #784; persistence and import round-trip remain pending. The remaining 28 fields require field-level mutability evidence.

semantic_summary.rule: Semantic definition is distinct from mutability, persistence, import round-trip, and canonical Registry identity. No calculation is inferred where Oracle does not define one.

mutability_review.rule: StatusCode now has canonical identity and current-main mutability aligned to Oracle Read Only via #784. Historical Web Services and Gateway Data Dictionary metadata remain supporting evidence; persistence and import round-trip are still separate certification gates.
